findings.claim: The new text test reads the temp location directly instead of using the platform path helper.
findings.evidence: The spec requirement `No environment or literal locations` says `No module in this repository other than lib/platform/paths.mjs SHALL read a home or temp location from the environment or from a literal`; this file imports `os` and calls `os.tmpdir()` in `mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'text-'))`.

findings.claim: The paths test reads home and temp locations directly outside the only module allowed to do so.
findings.evidence: The spec requirement `No environment or literal locations` says `No module in this repository other than lib/platform/paths.mjs SHALL read a home or temp location from the environment or from a literal`; this file imports `os` and calls `os.homedir()` and `os.tmpdir()`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either revise the requirement to explicitly exempt tests that assert default OS behaviour, or avoid direct OS-location reads in this test and cover defaults through an injected abstraction.
